s: house with ox-stalls has dimensions twelve Vîtâras, nine Vîtâras, and six Vîtâras (largest, middle, and smallest parts respectively)
q: Twelve Vîtâras in the largest part of the house, nine Vîtâras in the middle part, six Vîtâras in the smallest part.

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes hard wood (ten thousand loads brought to the fire of Ahura Mazda as atonement)
q: He shall godly and piously bring unto the fire of Ahura Mazda ten thousand loads of hard, well dried, well examined wood, as an atonement unto the soul (of the water dog).

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes beds with cushions (given to godly men)
q: He shall godly and piously give to godly men godly beds with cushions

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes virgin maid (given to a godly man)
q: He shall godly and piously give to a godly man a virgin maid, whom no man has known

s: virgin maid is a sister or daughter (of the giver; at the age of puberty, with ear-rings, and past her fifteenth year)
q: A sister or a daughter of his, at the age of puberty, with ear-rings in her ears, and past her fifteenth year.

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes small cattle (twice seven head given to holy men)
q: He shall godly and piously give to holy men twice seven head of small cattle

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes young dogs (twice seven brought up)
q: He shall bring up twice seven whelps.

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes bridges (twice seven thrown over canals)
q: He shall throw twice seven bridges over canals.

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes stables (twice nine put into repair)
q: He shall put into repair twice nine stables that are out of repair.

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes dogs (twice nine cleansed from specified conditions and diseases)
q: He shall cleanse twice nine dogs from skin humours, hair wax, vermin, and all the diseases that are produced on the body of a dog.

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes meat (for twice nine godly men to their fill)
q: He shall treat twice nine godly men to their fill of meat, bread, strong, drink, and wine.

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes bread (for twice nine godly men to their fill)
q: He shall treat twice nine godly men to their fill of meat, bread, strong, drink, and wine.

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes strong drink (for twice nine godly men to their fill)
q: He shall treat twice nine godly men to their fill of meat, bread, strong, drink, and wine.

s: penalty for killing a water dog includes wine (for twice nine godly men to their fill)
q: He shall treat twice nine godly men to their fill of meat, bread, strong, drink, and wine.

s: penalty for killing a water dog is atonement and penalty (for the deed of killing a water dog)
q: This is the atonement, this is the penalty that he shall undergo to atone for the deed that he has done.

s: world of the holy ones is entered by person who undergoes the penalty for killing a water dog (if he undergoes the prescribed atonement)
q: If he shall undergo it, he shall enter the world of the holy ones

s: Fargard XV is a fargard
q: Fargard XV.

s: man supports damsel (when she conceives by him, until the child is born)
q: If a man come near unto a damsel, either dependent on the chief of the family or not dependent, either delivered unto a husband or not delivered, and she conceives by him, so long shall he support her, until the child is born.

s: damsel conceives pregnancy (after a man comes near unto her)
q: If a man come near unto a damsel, either dependent on the chief of the family or not dependent, either delivered unto a husband or not delivered, and she conceives by him

s: induced miscarriage is a murder (when the damsel destroys the fruit in her womb)
q: And if the damsel, from dread of the people, shall destroy the fruit in her womb, the sin is on both the father and herself, the murder is on both the father and herself

s: man commands Cause thy fruit to perish!
q: and the man says, "Cause thy fruit to perish!" and she causes her fruit to perish; the sin is on the head of all three, the man, the damsel, and the old woman

s: induced miscarriage involves Banga (as a drug that produces miscarriage)
q: the old woman brings her some Banga, or Shaêta, or Ghnâna, or Fraspâta, or some other of the drugs that produce miscarriage

s: induced miscarriage involves Shaêta (as a drug that produces miscarriage)
q: the old woman brings her some Banga, or Shaêta, or Ghnâna, or Fraspâta, or some other of the drugs that produce miscarriage

s: induced miscarriage involves Ghnâna (as a drug that produces miscarriage)
q: the old woman brings her some Banga, or Shaêta, or Ghnâna, or Fraspâta, or some other of the drugs that produce miscarriage

s: induced miscarriage involves Fraspâta (as a drug that produces miscarriage)
q: the old woman brings her some Banga, or Shaêta, or Ghnâna, or Fraspâta, or some other of the drugs that produce miscarriage

s: Ahura Mazda answers Zarathustra (as the Holy One)
q: Ahura Mazda answered: ‘There are five such sins, O holy Zarathustra!

s: supporting a pregnant female applies to woman (whether two-footed or four-footed)
q: It lies with the faithful to look in the same way after every pregnant female, either two-footed or four-footed, either woman or bitch.

s: supporting a pregnant female applies to bitch (whether two-footed or four-footed)
q: It lies with the faithful to look in the same way after every pregnant female, either two-footed or four-footed, either woman or bitch.

s: worshippers of Mazda support pregnant female (as a general duty)
q: It lies with the faithful to look in the same way after every pregnant female, either two-footed or four-footed, either woman or bitch.

s: bitch requires supporting a pregnant female (when near her time and lying in a dangerous or occupied place)
q: If (a bitch) be near her time and be lying on the high road, which is the worshipper of Mazda that shall support her

s: bitch is supported by man (when lying on the high road, by the person whose house stands nearest)
q: He whose house stands-nearest, the care of supporting her is his; so long shall he support her until the whelps are born.

s: bitch rests on litter (when lying in the middle of a pasture-field)
q: He shall with kind charity take her to rest upon a litter of any foliage fit for a litter

s: young dogs may be let loose let loose (whether it be winter or summer)
q: When they are able to run about in a circuit of twice seven houses around. Then they may be let loose, whether it be winter or summer.

s: young dogs are supported for six months
q: Young dogs ought to be supported for six months, children for seven years.

s: child is supported for seven years
q: Young dogs ought to be supported for six months, children for seven years.

s: Âtar watches over bitch (as well as over a woman)
q: Âtar, the son of Ahura Mazda, watches as well (over a pregnant bitch) as he does over a woman.

s: Peshôtanu is a committer of certain unconfessed and unatoned sins (when the sins are committed and not confessed or atoned for)
q: How many are the sins that men commit and that, being committed and not confessed, nor atoned for, make their committer a Peshôtanu?

s: breeding a bitch with three dogs produces strong offspring (when the bitch is covered by three dogs)
q: The bitch being thus covered by three dogs, grows big with young, and the milk comes to her teats and she brings forth a young one that is born from (three) dogs.

s: breeding a bitch with three dogs requires three dogs (each kept apart from the former lest they assail one another)
q: They shall afterwards let another dog come near her, and then a third besides, each being kept apart from the former, lest they should assail one another.

s: bitch produces milk (after being covered by three dogs and growing big with young)
q: The bitch being thus covered by three dogs, grows big with young, and the milk comes to her teats

s: wilful murder penalty is penalty for wilful murder (for failing to support a pregnant female so that the offspring comes to mischief)
q: If he shall not support her, so that the whelps come to mischief, for want of proper support, he shall pay the penalty for wilful murder.

s: worshippers of Mazda receive foreign wrong creed (when taught by a man knowingly and conscientiously as a sin)
q: It is the first of these sins that men commit when a man teaches one of the faithful a foreign, wrong creed, a foreign wrong law, and he does so with a full knowledge and conscience of the sin

s: man commits teaching a foreign wrong creed (with full knowledge and conscience of the sin)
q: when a man teaches one of the faithful a foreign, wrong creed, a foreign wrong law, and he does so with a full knowledge and conscience of the sin: this is a sin that makes him a Peshôtanu.

s: teaching a foreign wrong creed is a sin (one of five sins making the committer a Peshôtanu)
q: It is the first of these sins that men commit when a man teaches one of the faithful a foreign, wrong creed, a foreign wrong law

s: intercourse with a menstruating woman is a sin (when the woman has an issue of blood)
q: It is the fourth of these sins that men commit when a man has intercourse with a woman who has an issue of blood, either out of the ordinary course or at the usual period: this is a sin that makes him a Peshôtanu.

s: Ahura Mazda is a Maker of the material world
q: O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: house of a worshipper of Mazda contains woman who has an issue of blood
q: If there be in the house of a worshipper of Mazda a woman who has an issue of blood, either out of the ordinary course or at the usual period

s: place of infirmity is a place for a woman who has an issue of blood
q: she shall sit in the place of infirmity until four nights have passed.

s: Fire is separated from woman who has an issue of blood (by fifteen paces)
q: Fifteen paces from the fire, fifteen paces from the water, fifteen paces from the consecrated bundles of baresma, three paces from the faithful.

s: water is separated from woman who has an issue of blood (by fifteen paces)
q: Fifteen paces from the fire, fifteen paces from the water, fifteen paces from the consecrated bundles of baresma, three paces from the faithful.

s: blood is seen after three nights (by the woman who has an issue of blood)
q: If she still see blood after three nights have passed, she shall sit in the place of infirmity until four nights have passed.

s: issue of blood has type ordinary issue (in one case)
q: so that the ordinary issue turns to the dye of the unusual one, or the unusual issue to the dye of the ordinary one

s: issue of blood has type unusual issue (in one case)
q: so that the ordinary issue turns to the dye of the unusual one, or the unusual issue to the dye of the ordinary one

s: intercourse with a menstruating woman with woman who has an issue of blood (is a grave offense)
q: Whosoever shall lie in sexual intercourse with a woman who has an issue of blood, either out of the ordinary course or at the usual period, does no better deed than if he should burn the corpse of his own son, born of his own body and dead of naêza, and drop its fat into the fire.

s: Peshôtanu incurs two hundred stripes with the Aspahê-astra, two hundred stripes with the Sraoshô-karana
q: He is a Peshôtanu: two hundred stripes with the Aspahê-astra, two hundred stripes with the Sraoshô-karana.

s: Peshôtanu receives two hundred stripes (with the Aspahê-astra)
q: He is a Peshôtanu: two hundred stripes with the Aspahê-astra, two hundred stripes with the Sraoshô-karana.

s: Ahura Mazda is a Holy One
q: O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: Drug is embodied by sinners (all such sinners)
q: All such sinners, embodiments of the Drug, are scorners of the law

s: Daêvas cause issue of blood (when it persists beyond nine nights)
q: If she still see blood after nine nights have passed, this is a work of the Daêvas which they have performed for the worship and glorification of the Daêvas.

s: Angra Mainyu makes Khrafstras
q: two hundred of any other sort of the Khrafstras made by Angra Mainyu, if it be winter.

s: worshippers of Mazda is a faithful
q: three paces from the faithful.

s: Ahura Mazda is rebelled against by all scorners of the law
q: all scorners of the law are rebels against the Lord

s: corpse of his own son is burned in comparison to intercourse with a menstruating woman (as a deed no better than sexual intercourse with a woman who has an issue of blood)
q: does no better deed than if he should burn the corpse of his own son, born of his own body and dead of naêza, and drop its fat into the fire.

s: woman who has an issue of blood has issue of blood (out of the ordinary course or at the usual period)
q: If there be in the house of a worshipper of Mazda a woman who has an issue of blood, either out of the ordinary course or at the usual period

s: woman who has an issue of blood is separated from Fire (by fifteen paces)
q: Fifteen paces from the fire, fifteen paces from the water, fifteen paces from the consecrated bundles of baresma, three paces from the faithful.

s: woman who has an issue of blood is separated from water (by fifteen paces)
q: Fifteen paces from the fire, fifteen paces from the water, fifteen paces from the consecrated bundles of baresma, three paces from the faithful.

s: woman who has an issue of blood is separated from consecrated bundles of baresma (by fifteen paces)
q: Fifteen paces from the fire, fifteen paces from the water, fifteen paces from the consecrated bundles of baresma, three paces from the faithful.

s: woman who has an issue of blood is separated from worshippers of Mazda (by three paces)
q: Fifteen paces from the fire, fifteen paces from the water, fifteen paces from the consecrated bundles of baresma, three paces from the faithful.

s: Ahura Mazda is a Spirit (most beneficent)
q: Ahura Mazda answered: ‘It is when a man here below combing his hair or shaving it off, or paring off his nails drops them in a hole or in a crack

s: hair is a material requiring ritual disposal (after being combed or shaved off)
q: whenever here below thou shalt comb thy hair or shave it off, or pare off thy nails, thou shalt take them away ten paces from the faithful

s: nails is a material requiring ritual disposal (after being pared off)
q: For the nails, thou shalt dig a hole, out of the house, as deep as the top joint of the little finger

s: hair is disposed of hole (in the earth, at specified distances)
q: thou shalt dig a hole, a disti deep if the earth be hard, a vîtasti deep if it be soft; thou shalt take the hair down there

s: nails is disposed of hole (out of the house)
q: For the nails, thou shalt dig a hole, out of the house, as deep as the top joint of the little finger; thou shalt take the nails down there

s: hole has depth a disti (when the earth is hard, for hair)
q: thou shalt dig a hole, a disti deep if the earth be hard

s: hole has depth a vîtasti (when the earth is soft, for hair)
q: a vîtasti deep if it be soft

s: hole has depth top joint of the little finger (for nails)
q: For the nails, thou shalt dig a hole, out of the house, as deep as the top joint of the little finger

s: Ahura Mazda is a Maker (of the material world)
q: O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: Ahuna-Vairya is chanted three times (or six or nine)
q: and thou shall chant the Ahuna-Vairya three times, or six, or nine.

s: nails is offered to Ashô-zusta bird (as weapons against the Mâzainya Daêvas)
q: Look here, O Ashô-zusta bird! here are the nails for thee: look at the nails here! May they be for thee so many spears, knives, bows, falcon-winged arrows, and sling-stones against the Mâzainya Daêvas!

s: nails becomes weapons (when dedicated to the Ashô-zusta bird)
q: May they be for thee so many spears, knives, bows, falcon-winged arrows, and sling-stones against the Mâzainya Daêvas!

s: nails is held by Mâzainya fiends (when not dedicated to the Ashô-zusta bird)
q: If those nails have not been dedicated (to the bird), they shall be in the hands of the Mâzainya Daêva so many spears, knives, bows, falcon-winged arrows, and sling stones

s: Mâzainya fiends is a Daêvas
q: May they be for thee so many spears, knives, bows, falcon-winged arrows, and sling-stones against the Mâzainya Daêvas!

s: Ahura Mazda is a Holy One
q: O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: Daêvas has baleful strength
q: Which is the most deadly deed whereby a man increases most the baleful strength of the Daêvas, as he would do by offering them a sacrifice?

s: Daêvas is a produced beings (in the earth when lawful rites are not observed)
q: Then for want of the lawful rites being observed, Daêvas are produced in the earth

s: lawful rites is a rites (required to prevent the production of Daêvas and Khrafstras)
q: Then for want of the lawful rites being observed, Daêvas are produced in the earth; for want of the lawful rites being observed, those Khrafstras are produced in the earth

s: Afrinagan, Gahs and Miscellaneous Fragments has title Afrinagan, Gahs and Miscellaneous Fragments
Afrinagan, Gahs and Miscellaneous Fragments has source class canonical
Righteousness the Best is a lofty lord (the Ritual Righteousness itself)
q: of that lofty lord who is the Ritual Righteousness (itself)

s: Maidhyô-zaremya is a lord
q: To Maidhyô-zaremya, the lord

s: Ahura Mazda is worshipped by I
q: I confess myself a Mazda-worshipper, and of Zarathustra's order, a foe of the Daêvas, devoted to the lore of the Lord

s: Myazda is a ritual offering (associated with the seasonal festival)
q: present ye the Myazda which is that of the Maidhyô-zaremaya

q: the first Myazda which is that of the Maidhyô-zaremaya

s: Ratu expels the disciple (when the disciple brings no Myazda)
q: the Ratu that has the right to that Myazda, and who has this person under his guidance, expels that (false) disciple

s: the worshipper ascribes power to Myazda (with the mind's offering)
q: then let the worshipper (with the mind's offering) ascribe the power to him who rules the best, Ahura

s: the royal Province-chiefs are worshippers of Ahura Mazda (faithful worshippers)
q: I bless with my prayer the royal Province-chiefs (who are faithful worshippers) of Ahura Mazda

s: Âfrîn[-Agân] Gâtha is a Gâtha
q: II. Âfrîn[-Agân] Gâtha.

s: Zarathustra has order Mazda-worshippers
q: I confess myself a Mazda-worshipper, and of Zarathustra's order

s: the Kingdom belongs to Ahura Mazda
q: and the Kingdom (is) to Mazda

s: the Bountiful Immortals are a holy beings (bountiful)
q: and of the Bountiful Immortals

s: lofty Gâthas are a ritual powers (bountiful and holy; ruling in the ritual order)
q: for the bountiful and holy Gâthas which rule in the ritual order

s: Mazdayasnians are present at ritual service (as assembled worshippers)
q: O ye Mazdayasnians who are here present! offer ye this ritual service

s: Fravashis of the saints belong to saints (mighty and overwhelming)
q: Propitiation to the Fravashis of the saints, the mighty, overwhelming

s: Gâh Rapithvin is a lord of the ritual order (holy)
q: for Rapithwina, the holy lord of the ritual order

q: and for Frâdat-fshu and Zantuma, the holy lord(s) of the ritual order

s: Gâh Rapithvin has associated lords Zantuma (holy lord of the ritual order)
q: and for Frâdat-fshu and Zantuma, the holy lord(s) of the ritual order

s: the Rapithwina office is performed with the Rapithwina blessing
q: who shall recite the Rapithwina office with the Rapithwina prayer for blessing

s: the lore of the Lord is devoted to Ahura Mazda
q: devoted to the lore of the Lord

s: the Rapithwina ritual requires Baresman (spread)
q: and who shall sacrifice with the Rapithwina office with hands (well) washed, and with (well) washed mortars, with the Baresman spread

s: the Rapithwina ritual requires Haoma (high uplifted)
q: and with Haoma high uplifted

s: the Rapithwina ritual requires Ahuna-vairya (loud intoned)
q: with Ahuna-vairya loud intoned

s: the Rapithwina ritual requires fire (brightly flaming)
q: with fire brightly flaming

s: Gâh Hâvan is a lord of the ritual order (holy; regulator of the ritual order)
q: for the holy Hâvani, the regulator of the ritual order (and its lord in its turn)

s: Zarathustra is a saint
q: And we sacrifice to Ahura Mazda the holy lord of the ritual Order, and to Zarathustra, and to the Fravashi of Zarathustra, the saint.

s: Zarathustra founds Mazdayasnians (of Zarathustra's order)
q: I confess myself a Mazda-worshipper, of Zarathustra's order

s: Mazdayasnians is a foe to the Daêvas
q: I confess myself a Mazda-worshipper, of Zarathustra's order, a foe to the Daêvas

s: Mithra of the wide pastures is a Yazad (of the spoken name; of the thousand ears and myriad eyes)
q: And to Mithra of the wide pastures, of the thousand ears, of the myriad eyes, the Yazad of the spoken name

s: the Bountiful Immortals is a guardians (of the saints)
q: And we sacrifice to the Bounteous Immortals, (the guardians) of the saints

s: Fravashi of Zarathustra belongs to Zarathustra (saintly Fravashi)
q: and to Zarathustra, and to the Fravashi of Zarathustra, the saint.

q: And we sacrifice to the Hâvani, the holy lord of the ritual order

s: Airyemâ-ishyô is a holy lord of the ritual order (powerful and victoriously smiting)
q: and we sacrifice to the Airyemâ-ishyô, the holy lord of the ritual order, the powerful, victoriously smiting

s: the five Gâthas is a Mãthra (surpassing)
q: for the effective invocation of that surpassing Mãthra, the five Gâthas.

s: Fire is a holy lord of the ritual order
q: And we sacrifice to thee, the Fire, O Ahura Mazda's son, the holy lord of the ritual order.

s: Fire is son of Ahura Mazda
q: the Fire, O Ahura Mazda's son

s: Apãm-napât is a lofty and royal lord (brilliant and of the fleet horses)
q: that lofty and royal lord, the brilliant Apãm-napât of the fleet horses

s: Righteousness the Best is a a blessing
q: A blessing is Asha Vahista.

s: Righteousness the Best is a Righteousness the Best
q: And we sacrifice to Asha Vahista (who is Righteousness the Best)

s: Gâh Rapithvin is a holy lord of the ritual order
q: And we sacrifice to the Rapithwina, the holy lord of the ritual order

s: Zantuma is a holy lord of the ritual order
q: And we (therefore) sacrifice to Zantuma (as) the holy lord of the ritual order.

s: Zantuma is a lord
q: for the sacrifice and homage of Zantuma, the lord.

s: Dahvyuma is a holy lord of the ritual order
q: And we sacrifice to Dahvyuma, the holy lord of the ritual order.

q: Propitiation be to Sraosha (Obedience) the blessed, endowed with recompense

q: We sacrifice to the Uzayêirina, the holy lord of the ritual order.

s: Gâh Ushahin has part Good Mind
q: And we sacrifice to Ahura Mazda, the holy lord of the ritual order, and to the Good Mind

s: Gâh Ushahin has part Khshathra-vairya
q: and to Khshathra-vairya, and to Âramaiti, the bounteous and the good.

q: and to Khshathra-vairya, and to Âramaiti, the bounteous and the good.

q: And we sacrifice to Aiwisrûthrima (and) Aibigaya, the holy lord(s) of the ritual order

s: Gâh Ushahin is a holy lord of the ritual order
q: We sacrifice to Ushahina, the holy lord of the ritual order

s: Ahura Mazda rules creatures (as sovereign over creatures which are his)

q: to the Blow of Victory, Ahura-given
